en: What's this room?
Oh my, is this a sewing machine?
What's this doing inside the labyrinth of all places?
And not just that...
This is a pattern, isn't it, for another magic dress?
Ah, I know!
What do you think, Mikhail?
Yes, indeed.  This sewing machine will do just fine for making magic dresses.
Really?  Huzzah!
But do you believe you can handle this?  Dressmaking is fairly complicated.
Are you patronizing me?  Of course I know how to make a dress.. I am a proper lady, don't you know!
Begging your pardon, ma'am.
Sheesh, I'm going to lose my temper at this rate!
Anyway, Mikhail, how long do you plan on hanging out here?
Huh?
You can go back now.
Eh?  You mean that was all you wanted to see me about?
Indeed.
Okay, 'tis time for all good sorcerers to return home. :)
Whew, let's get down to business.
So, self, shall we try crafting from this pattern?

note: sfx: Obtained the pattern for the magic dress Litense

en: A bible and holy water.  And the dress.
Now I've gathered up everything.
What's up!  Nothing special is happening here!
Mikhail, you're touched in the head!
"Just trust me on this"?  Oh come on.
"Something's going to happen"?  Yeah right.
Oh for heaven's sake what the heck am I supposed to do now.
I won't be able to save Father like this!
Oh, Father....
Eh?  W-what?!
Ah!  The bible and holy water are glowing?!
Kyaaa!
Wait, what?  What just happened?
Daughter.
Eh?!
Daughter.  Your feelings towards your Father, your wish...  I have heard your plea.
Wait, who?  Who are you?
I bestow power onto you.  Onto your soul and into your dress, the power necessary for your task.
It is the power to protect someone important to you.  Hallowed power to purify the wicked.
This holy sword!!
Kyaaaaa?!
Oof.
Sheesh, what the devil was that!
Oh, what's this?
Such a beautiful blade...
This must be the holy sword.
So this is what Mikhail meant.
Now that I have this sacred sword, I should be able to help Father. Surely!
Now, let's hurry on to where Father is!
But, that voice, I wonder whose it was?
Surely not God's?!
Yeah, like that could happen.
